definitions.explanation: Employment or tasks one does professionally. Also refers to specific tasks or duties.
A specific piece of work that needs to be done.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わりました→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
{仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go for drinks after work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕事|しごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My job is being a teacher, and I enjoy working every day.
I have a lot of work today.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{仕事|しごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{終|お}わらせたい→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to finish this task quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{仕事|しごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わらせなければならない→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of work that I have to finish by next week. I might work on the weekend too.

notes:
{仕事|しごと} is one of the most common nouns in Japanese, meaning work, job, or task.

VERBAL USE:
{仕事|しごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or {仕事|しごと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to work
- {仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧: work ends
- {仕事|しごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a job
- {仕事|しごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辞|や}める→辞める：00909_yameru⟧: to quit one's job
- {仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧: to be busy with work

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{仕事中|しごとちゅう}→仕事中：noentry⟧: at work, during work
- ⟦{仕事場|しごとば}→仕事場：18830_shigotoba⟧: workplace
- ⟦{仕事着|しごとぎ}→仕事着：noentry⟧: work clothes
- {仕事|しごと}⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧: on the way home from work

NUANCE:
Refers to both one's occupation/profession and specific tasks or assignments. For occupation, ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧ is more formal.
